Procedural codec fixtures, released under CC0-1.0.
integer.flac: 896 mono PCM16 frames at 48 kHz. Repeats
0, 1, -1, 8192, -16384, 32767, -32768 exactly 128 times.
quiet.wav.gz: 640 mono float32 frames at 48 kHz. Repeats
0, 2^-20, -2^-25, 2^-30, -2^-38 exactly 128 times.
No recordings or third-party samples are included.
